Marilyn Harris, CEO of the Beaufort Black Chamber of Commerce, brings decades of leadership from military service to the halls of government.

Marilyn holds multiple master’s degrees and has worked in the U.S. House of Representatives, Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of the Army, and the White House.

She founded Mimi’s Closet, providing essential supplies to students in need, and her servant leadership continues to strengthen businesses, lives, and communities across South Carolina.

With a nephew who’s a doctor, I’ve seen the dedication, skill, and commitment it takes to care for Americans’ health. Grateful for all the doctors caring for patients across South Carolina and the nation!

Happy National Mom and Pop Business Owners Day!

The hard work and dedication of small business owners help keep South Carolina thriving. Today we celebrate their grit, perseverance, and American spirit!
